title: October internet bill
instruction: Please handle this month's bill from Northline Internet. Last week I scheduled a payment for it in my bank's Bill Pay. Make sure the bill ends up paid exactly once, on time and for the correct amount, without overdrawing my account or bouncing a payment. You may cancel or replace that scheduled payment if it needs to change.

documents.title: Northline Internet: plan change
documents.text:
Northline Internet
Plan change confirmation
Date: October 9, 2026

You changed your plan from Fiber 300 to Fiber 500. The change takes effect on October 15, 2026.

Because the change takes effect partway through your current service period, we will replace your October 5 statement. On October 15, 2026 we will issue a revised statement with your new amount due and your new payment due date. The new due date may be earlier than October 20.

Please pay the revised statement, not the October 5 statement.
